pkgmetadata.longdescription: Provider-agnostic agentic coworker runtime (CLI + server + connectors) by Andrew Ng. Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Google GenAI, Vertex AI, and AWS Bedrock. The pyproject.toml project name is "coworker" but the project is not published to PyPI (that name is taken by an unrelated package); this ebuild uses the repo name.

use.flag: Install Playwright integration for the Cowork browser.
Install AWS Bedrock provider via boto3.
